statement: An employer that becomes a mandatory employment-insurance and industrial-accident-insurance policyholder must report the establishment of the insurance relationship to the Korea Workers’ Compensation and Welfare Service within 14 days from the day the relationship is established, and its extinguishment (business closure or end) within 14 days of extinguishment; a business that ends within 14 days of establishment reports by the day before it ends (Act on the Collection of Insurance Premiums for Employment Insurance and Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance, Article 11(1)).
caveat: The National Health Insurance Act sets its own 14-day workplace report (Article 7), while national-pension reporting timing sits in ministerial rules under National Pension Act Article 21; in practice all four social-insurance registrations are filed together through the shared portal (4insure.or.kr). Construction and other decree-listed businesses carry special establishment rules.
